title: Exact streaming incremental byte-pair tokenization
coding_guidance: Edit only model.py; never modify eval.py/data.py/task_spec.json. Preserve IncrementalBPE(vocab,rules,config), append(byte) returning last token ID, and tokens() returning all current prefix token IDs. Exact priority-ranked BPE, not longest-match tokenization.
metric_description: Median CPU wall-time includes OS/CPU noise; rerun tolerance 50%, not bitwise timings.
